description: Default options of the yamlprims specification revision 1.4: YAML 1.2.2 Core resolution (section 4), integers limited to i128::MIN..=u128::MAX, explicit core tags directing resolution, non-core tags retained with a raw string inner, duplicate keys rejected (section 5.2), strict flow indentation in every parsing pass (section 9), merge_keys = AsKey (section 5.3), and single-document entrypoints. Error kinds are the specification's snake_case ErrorKind names. Revision 1.4 defines source collection level p and completed height H (1.4/E-1), bytes-only anchor registration (1.4/E-2), and source-validation precedence, capacity-before-duplicate admission, copy-limit order, and completed-key weight (1.4/E-3). Cases bound to this revision use those rules. This file carries no cases; the first boundary rows use explicit-limits profiles that cite the same specification bytes.
